summary.sideDetailPolicy: Side detail assets use a compressed visual scale: smallest aircraft are about 80% of the largest, preserving detail-screen readability.
summary.topMapPolicy: Top-map assets use compressed physical scaling: display size = maxFill * canvas * (max(length,wingspan) / 88.4)^0.3.
